one_line: The paper develops and simulates an energy-savings baseline and energy management control system (EMCS) applied to an automotive aluminium-component (parts) manufacturing plant that melts ingot/scrap, casts, machines, and assembles discrete parts, with direct waste-heat reuse; the listed continuous-flow sectors (steel, pulp & paper, glass) appear only as literature/reference mentions.
